excerpt.zh: 大势已去。我们……我们提出无条件投降。
excerpt.en: All is lost. We... we offer our unconditional surrender.

scope.en: Root and trigger, conditions, options and outcomes, and category checked against the game files; bilingual guide written.

texts.zh: 大势已去。我们……我们提出无条件投降。
texts.en: All is lost. We... we offer our unconditional surrender.

texts.zh: 求你们召回舰队吧！我们已经向你们投降了！
texts.en: Please, call off your fleets! You have our surrender!

texts.zh: 我们所创的丰功伟绩……所建的一切……全都毁于一旦了。
texts.en: All we have accomplished... everything we have built... gone.

texts.zh: 愿圣灵能原谅你的罪孽……但我们决不能原谅！
texts.en: May the spirits forgive you for your sins... we never will.

texts.zh: 我们哪里做错了？我们的信仰还不够坚定吗？我们的祈祷还不够多吗？我……我不明白……
texts.en: Where did we fail? Was our faith lacking? Were the prayers not enough? I... I just don't understand...

texts.zh: 卧薪尝胆，我们将会变得比穷尽你的想象来的还要更强。
texts.en: By striking us down, we shall become more powerful than you could possibly imagine.

texts.zh: 我们已经下令让所有的剩余部队放下武器。战争结束了……一切也都结束了。
texts.en: We have instructed all of our remaining forces to lay down their arms. The war is over... everything is.

texts.zh: 我、我们向你们无条件投降。我们不干了。
texts.en: You... you have our unconditional surrender. We are standing down.

texts.zh: 告诉我们的将士们，他们无责于我们的战败。是我……是我无颜面对他们……
texts.en: Tell our warriors there was no shame in our defeat. I... I cannot face them...

texts.zh: 求你了，我们放弃一切抵抗。我们……我们就想重归和平。
texts.en: Please, we will offer no more resistance. We... we only want peace.

texts.zh: 愿整个宇宙宽恕你的罪行。
texts.en: May the universe forgive you for your crimes.

texts.zh: 我们的抵抗简直是太愚蠢了。无数的生命……无谓地牺牲了。
texts.en: It was foolish of us to resist. So many lives lost... all for nothing.

texts.zh: 在这情况下继续抵抗……就太不理智了。我们向你们全面投降。
texts.en: Continued resistance at this point would be... irrational. You have our total surrender.

texts.zh: 我们会与你们的占领部队配合，以期顺利……解散我们现在的政府。
texts.en: We will cooperate with your occupation forces as they see to the... dismantlement of our current government.

texts.zh: 我们才刚刚要解开星系奥秘的面纱。我们还有很多想知道的……
texts.en: We were only beginning to unlock the mysteries of the galaxy. There was so much more to learn...

texts.zh: 您将会在一小时之内在您的办公桌上看到董事会的集体辞呈……
texts.en: You will have the resignations of all Board members on your desk within the hour...

texts.zh: 依据我们投降书的细节，我们将会尽快开始……我们公司的破产清算。
texts.en: As per the details of our surrender, we shall begin the... the liquidation process of our company in a prompt manner.

texts.zh: 这不是我在经营蓝图上所描绘的未来……
texts.en: This is not the future I had envisaged in our business plan...

texts.zh: 我们……我们会死的。你杀死了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]。我们……我们不想……死……
texts.en: We... we are dying. You have killed the [from.GetGestaltEntityName]. We... do not want... to die...

texts.zh: 我们所积累的知识、经验……思想……我们所见的一切。这些都会在数秒钟之内瓦解，而你什么都不知道。你根本不懂。
texts.en: The knowledge contained within us, the experiences... the thoughts... the things we have seen. It will all be gone in a few seconds, and you have no idea. You have no idea.

texts.zh: 没有了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]，我们动弹不得。没有了[from.GetGestaltEntityName]……就……就没有了一切……
texts.en: Without the [from.GetGestaltEntityName], we cannot function. Without the [from.GetGestaltEntityName]... there... there is nothing...

texts.zh: 次优解算结果！次优解算结果！次——优——解——……滋滋……
texts.en: Suboptimal outcome! Suboptimal outcome! Suuuuboooptiiimaa... bzzt...

texts.zh:
清空全部数据库。过载核心能源中心。自毁程序已启动。

祝安，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
texts.en:
Purging all databanks. Overloading central power hubs. Self-destruct sequence initiated.

Have a nice day, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

texts.zh:
尝试重建无人机链接……
尝试失败。 程序变更……
尝试重建舰队单位链接……
尝试失败。 程序变更……
尝试重建行星控制中心链接……
尝试失败。 程序变更……
texts.en:
Attempting to reestablish connection with drones......
FAILED. Rerouting...
Attempting to reestablish connection with fleet units.....
FAILED. Rerouting...
Attempting to reestablish connection with planetary control hubs......
FAILED. Rerouting...

texts.zh: 这……这不是预言中的结局。
texts.en: This... this is not the ending that was foretold.

texts.zh: 城门大破……蛮族已至。万事皆休！
texts.en: The gates are smashed... the barbarians have broken through. This is the end!

texts.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们想要我们卑躬屈膝？还是想要我们求饶？

别做梦了！

有本事你就滚过来，你个肮脏的[Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]！我会用这块锋利的瓦砾刺穿你！
texts.en:
Do you want us to grovel, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? Beg, perhaps?

NEVER!

Come here if you dare, you vile [Root.GetSpeciesNameInsult]! I will impale you on this jagged piece of rubble!

texts.zh: 哎，你这愚蠢的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。如果你能够悉听我们的教导的话，这样的事情是可以避免的！看看你们都做了什么。
texts.en: Oh, you foolish, foolish [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. This could have been avoided if only you had allowed us to guide you! Now look what you have done.

texts.zh: 惩罚进程失败。自卫协议终止。投降协议启动。
texts.en: Punishment process failed. Self-defense protocols ended. Surrender protocols initiated.

texts.zh: [From.GetRulerTitle]万岁！帝国万岁！
texts.en: Long live the [From.GetRulerTitle]! Long live the Imperium!

texts.zh: 战争结束了。我们偃旗息鼓。
texts.en: This war is over. We admit defeat.

label.zh: 他们在这场试炼中并不够格。
label.en: They have been judged and found wanting.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

note.zh: 游戏会按政体显示统治者的头衔。
note.en: The game shows the ruler's title for your government.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现对你们的一种贬称。
note.en: In the game, a derogatory term for you appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你们的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, your species' name appears here.

summary.text:
# 战胜[From.GetName] / Victory against the [From.GetName]

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/on_action_events_1.txt:6228-6420; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3123 on_war_won · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

赢得战争时（on_war_won，00_on_actions.txt:3123），败者所有系统都已被宣称/国家将被毁灭时弹出（与 action.37 互斥）。

Fires on a won war (on_war_won, 00_on_actions.txt:3123) when all of the loser's systems are claimed and the country is to be destroyed (exclusive with action.37).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

一个窗口，正文三段随败者政府（通用、灵性、军国、和平、唯物……）与是否银河皇帝而变。

One window with a three-part text that varies with the loser's government (generic, spiritualist, militarist, pacifist, materialist ...) and whether it is the galactic emperor.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.
